title: Kissed Herbal Egyptian Chwinamul Bowl
description: A post-workout Egyptian dish featuring chwinamul, steam, and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients, this herbal and crumbly bowl is perfect for a snack. The combination of herbs and steam helps to rejuvenate the body after a workout.

ingredients.name: Chwinamul
ingredients.notes: Korean aster, can be substituted with other leafy greens

instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the pre-cooked brown rice, chopped parsley, and a pinch of salt.
In a small pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pan and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add the turmeric, cumin, and black pepper to the pan and stir for 1 minute.
Add the chwinamul to the pan and stir-fry for 3 minutes, or until the leaves are slightly wilted.
Add the cooked chwinamul mixture to the bowl with the brown rice and parsley.
Mix well and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the Kissed Herbal Egyptian Chwinamul Bowl hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
